question: List the components of MVC architecture.
answerMd:
### Swing MVC Architecture & Calculator GUI

**Model-View-Controller (MVC) in Swing:**
- **Model:** Represents state and business logic (e.g. `ButtonModel`, `TableModel`).
- **View:** The visual representation painted on screen (e.g. button shape, colors).
- **Controller:** Intercepts user gestures and updates the Model (e.g. mouse clicks, key events).

> In Swing, the View and Controller are unified into a single **UI Delegate** architecture (`ComponentUI`).

```java
JFrame frame = new JFrame("Simple Calculator");
JTextField display = new JTextField(15);
JButton btnAdd = new JButton("+");
```

$$\therefore \text{MVC decouples data models from visual rendering, ensuring clean GUI separation.}$$
